title: A brief stay with Phil Spitalny at the Edgewater Beach
summary: Julie Stein recommends him to Spitalny's hotel band, but he hates the corny muted wah-wah trumpet he is asked to play and leaves.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Well, was all of this period that you're talking about now before Phil Spitalny or after?
Well, it was after -- I did go with Phil---
You went with him right after Benny Meroff?

No, I went with him when -- Benny Maroff, at one point while we were with Benny at the Oriental, they sent Benny to Boston to rejuvenate a theater and see if he could bring back the stage band days; so, while he was there, I got a chance through Stein, you know, the composer, ---

Julie Stein -- he said, listen, Phil Spitalny's got a band at the Edgewater Beach and he needs a jazz trumpet player and he said, how would you like to have that? So, I thought this was a good time for me to get out of all this -- so, I went there and I stayed there a very short time because I couldn't take the band.
I didn't like the corny things he
He wanted you to do some wha - wha stuff---
Yeah - wha - wha music and that kind of stuff; my friends would be in the audience -- I was never so ashamed in my life, because I don't play that way with mutes and wha, wha things.

One of the interesting things about that -- I'm just going to put this on is that Julie Stein told me - it amazed him that he still remembers it all these years later is the way he would be playing the piano and he'd play a tune that you didn't know and he would give you the first note of the tune ---
The key -- and you'd go on and play it from there and he couldn't understand how you did that---

Well, I've been doing that all my life--- you see, there's a difference between reading notes and improvising all your life. So, that was no trick for me to do that. But, I didn't stay with Phil Spitalny I went with Meroff at the Oriental---
--and then, we went on the road trip from the Oriental--- that's the way it was. But, it was all right in that period---
